item.title: Lightpanda migrate DOM implementation to Zig
item.description:
📝 Another larger challenge, was integrating support for Custom Elements and ShadowDOM, written in Zig, with LibDOM. In the spirit of experimentation, this prototype also replaced V8 with QuickJS-NG. While this adds lookup overhead, it removes ~6 pointers from every element.
🔗 Read more: https://lightpanda.io/blog/posts/migrating-our-dom-to-zig

item.title: Fossil versus Git
item.description:
📝 Whenever Fossil is told to modify the local checkout in some destructive way (fossil rm, fossil update, fossil revert, etc. ) Fossil remembers the prior state and is able to return the check-out directory to that state with a fossil undo command. Fossil is small, complete, and self-contained.
🔗 Read more: https://fossil-scm.org/home/doc/trunk/www/fossil-v-git.wiki

item.title: Ai, Japanese chimpanzee who counted and painted dies at 49
item.description:
📝 When she was not participating in cognitive tests, Ai was known to enjoy drawing and painting. Japanese media outlet Kyodo news reported that she once escaped with another primate - using a key to unlock her cage.
